name: cited-fields
useFor: Use under an answer to show the values it read ("Flood zone, Zone X, 1"). Each `CitedField` takes a label, its value as children and a source number; put them in `CitedFields`, and both under a `SourceGroup` with the `Sources` list so pointing links them.
constraints: More than one value per row
title: Cited fields
description: The values an agent answer reports, each with its label and source chip, between Mist rules.
